chunks: Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about fish caught by the Magians.
He عليه السلام said: “There is no harm in it; the catching of fish is merely taking them.”

key_terms.أَخْذُهَا: taking them; the Imam's definition of valid fish capture in this context
key_terms.الْحِيتَانِ: fish; the sea animals being asked about in this ruling
key_terms.الْمَجُوسُ: the Magians; the non-Muslim group mentioned in the question
key_terms.صَيْدُ: catching or hunting; the legal act under discussion
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression indicating permissibility
key_terms.يَصِيدُهَا: catching them; performing the act of hunting or capture

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat fish caught by the Magians according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that fish caught by the Magians may be consumed without objection. The Imam عليه السلام explains that the valid capture of fish consists simply in taking them, which indicates a distinct legal treatment for fish in hunting law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4157 - Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani asked Abu Abdillah (as) about fish caught by the Magians.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it; the catching of fish is merely taking them."
